dialect.detail: ACUCOBOL-GT dialect; uses ACUCOBOL GUI extensions (acugui.def, acucobol.def), C$PARAMSIZE intrinsic, signed-long data type, 78-level constants, and XZOOM GUI framework. Italian-language ERP application.

purpose.domain_detail: Italian wholesale/distribution ERP system; lookup/zoom utility for customers, suppliers, articles, orders, invoices, warehouse movements, agents, price lists, promotions, and many other master data entities
purpose.summary: This is a large dispatch/router program for an ACUCOBOL-GT GUI zoom (lookup) facility used in an Italian ERP/distribution system. It receives a table/entity name via the LINKAGE SECTION, sets up the appropriate XZOOM grid configuration by performing one of many PREPARA-* paragraphs, then calls the XZOOM subprogram to display a searchable grid to the user. It covers a very wide range of business entities including clients, suppliers, articles, orders, invoices, warehouse causals, agents, and promotions.

notable_features: Large EVALUATE dispatch on string parameter (100+ WHEN branches)
COPY statements for external definitions and evaluate extensions
LINKAGE SECTION with COMO-FILE and COMO-RECORD parameters
SET ENVIRONMENT statements for XZOOM configuration
verdict.notes: File is truncated to first 16000 chars; full file is ~521KB / 10703 lines indicating a very large production program. Only the PROCEDURE DIVISION is present in the mechanical indicators (no IDENTIFICATION/ENVIRONMENT/DATA divisions detected), likely because those divisions are in COPY files or the file starts mid-program. The 'goba' at the end of the visible source appears to be a truncation artifact or a label. Italian ERP context is clear from entity names and comments.
